name: Shadow of Oryda
storyline:
You are an astronaut who crash-landed on the planet Oryda. And your goal – is to collect the wreckage of your ship and escape Oryda.
But this world is not just dangerous, it is hostile.
It is inhabited by aggressive life forms that hide traces of long-forgotten events. Locations are filled with ancient mechanisms that the astronaut must learn to master.
As you explore the planet, you begin to understand it.
Every fragment you find, every new ability, and every decision you make brings you closer to the answer: what happened to Oryda – and can it be saved?
summary: In this metroidvania, explore the hostile planet Oryda, collect your ship's wreckage, gain new abilities, build outposts and devices, play mini-games and fight bosses to uncover a mystery that might restore the world.
